# intercompany/

Intercompany mirror posting (plan: `docs/plans/2026-11-17-intercompany-mirror-posting.md`). P1 = connections only: nothing is sent between companies yet. Tables from migration 999p: `intercompany_connections`, `intercompany_connection_sides`, `company_connection_keys`, `intercompany_messages`, `intercompany_document_links` (the last three are tables, grants and RLS only; P2-P6 add their code).

## Modules
- `connectionService.ts` — barrel plus `createGroupConnection`, `revokeConnection`. `connectionSideService.ts` — `updateOwnSide`. `connectionRead.ts` — `listConnections`, `listGroupCandidates`. `connectionOptions.ts` — the side form's pick-lists.
- `connectionValidation.ts` — pure: request shapes (`parseCreateInput`, `parseSideInput`), `autoAcceptRefusal`, `orderedPair`, `computeChecklist`. `connectionTypes.ts` — types and `ConnectionRefusal` (status 400/403/404/409). `connectionRoute.ts` — the routes' answer for a refusal.

## Caller contract
Called by `pages/api/accounting/intercompany/*` (`connections`, `connections/[id]`, `group-candidates`, `side-options`) inside `withAuth`: `sql` is the request's transaction as app_user with the session company's GUCs, so RLS limits every read and write to the session company. Service functions take the session `companyId` (and `userId` where a role check needs it). A refusal is thrown as `ConnectionRefusal` before anything is written.

## Main function signatures
- `listConnections(companyId, connectionId?)` — this company's connections, each with ITS OWN side and setup checklist only.
- `createGroupConnection(userId, companyId, partnerCompanyId)` — write role in both; both current members (`left_date IS NULL`) of one group; a revoked group connection is re-activated, never duplicated.
- `updateOwnSide(companyId, connectionId, input)` — partial update (absent key unchanged, null clears) of the session company's side; upsert on (connection, company).
- `revokeConnection(companyId, connectionId)` — either party.

## Business rules
- The pair is stored ordered (`company_low_id < company_high_id`, `orderedPair`), unique. Kind never changes.
- A company never reads or writes its partner's side: RLS is `company_id = session company`. Customer/supplier must be the company's own (non-deleted); loan and default expense accounts its own, active and non-header (`isHeaderSql`). The database re-checks ownership in `intercompany_sides_guard`.
- `auto_accept` only on a `group` connection: `autoAcceptRefusal` in the service, `intercompany_sides_guard` (ENABLE ALWAYS trigger) in the database.
- A group connection is created `active`; the DB refuses one unless both companies are current members of one group. External connections (pending, accepted by the other company, connection keys) are P6; the guard trigger already enforces "the inviter cannot accept".
- Messages: UNIQUE (from company, source doc type, source doc id, kind); inserted only on an ACTIVE connection between its two companies; the sender only inserts, the receiver only moves a pending message on; a handled message is final (`intercompany_messages_guard`).
- Open for P2: a group connection stays `active` if a company later leaves the group; whatever writes on it (auto-accept worker) must re-check `intercompany_same_group` at the time.
